newsitem.title: USA: Saudi lowers crude prices to U.S. 15-20 cts/bbl.
newsitem.headline: Saudi lowers crude prices to U.S. 15-20 cts/bbl.

text.p: Saudi Arabia cut the price of term crude to the U.S. by 15-20 cents per barrel for April, lowering Berri Extra Light by 20 cts, traders said on Tuesday.
This takes Berri down to benchmark West Texas Intermediate -$2.35 from -$2.15 for March.
Traders said Arab Light for U.S. customers was lowered by 15 cts, putting April barrels at a differential of WTI -$3.45, from WTI -$3.30 in March.
Arab Medium also was decreased 15 cts to WTI -$4.50 from WTI -$4.35 in March.
Arab Heavy came down 15 cts as well, pegged for April at WTI -$5.35 from WTI -$5.20 in March, traders said.
